job.title: Maintenance Electrician

Key Responsibilities:

What We're Looking For:

  • Apprentice trained as an Electrical Maintenance Engineer
  • Ideally 18th Edition qualified; candidates with 16th/17th Edition will also be considered
  • Experience in single and 3 phase motors
  • Solid experience of heavy plant maintenance within an industrial environment
  • Strong fault-finding skills on PLCs, ideally Siemens
  • Experience with automated machinery and/or robotics
  • Working knowledge of HMI schedules and drives
  • Background in a heavy industrial, automated manufacturing, or FMCG environment
  • Willingness and ability to work the shift pattern outlined below

Shift Pattern:

A 2-shift rotating pattern, Monday to Friday:
